verdict.rationale: Zoom's AI Services auth docs describe creating API credentials where you choose scopes under Permissions, set an expiration, and restrict use with an IP allowlist. They also recommend short-lived JWTs that expire quickly and don't expose the secret. Together these are first-party least-privilege controls that apply directly to credentials issued for an agent. Missing for 10: detail on how granular the available scopes are, any agent-specific credential guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
